fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entrance at NE corner off Forest Lane (intersection with Hilltop Dr). Satellite z20-21 shows painted lane labels on pavement: 'VISITORS', 'TRUCKS', 'TRUCKS', 'CARS / EMPLOYEE' with discrete inbound lanes and a separate outbound 'TRUCKS' lane. Street View (2025-06) confirms a signalized entrance with painted lane markings and a guard structure.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Z21 satellite shows a small dark rectangular checkpoint structure (~1-2 vehicle footprint) at the throat of the inbound lanes, set between the inbound and outbound flows. Street View from Forest Ln confirms a small booth at the entrance throat.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Matches the reference #7 archetype: 3+ inbound lanes already painted with role labels (visitors/trucks/cars), wide gate apron with substantial unused paved width south of the booth where an express bypass lane could be added.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Three painted inbound lanes visible in z21 (VISITORS, TRUCKS, TRUCKS/CARS), counted as 3 truck-relevant inbound lanes. A bus lane is also present but excluded from the truck count.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single 'TRUCKS' outbound lane visible on the east side of the entrance throat.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Inbound and outbound share the same gate complex on the north property line at Forest Ln; separate lanes within a single gate group, not separate gates.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron immediately south of the gate, north of the dock face, provides queue/staging space for inbound trucks (~150m deep before reaching dock doors).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Approach apron from the gate to the dock doors is ~120m and 4-5 lanes wide; clearly holds 3+ trucks in queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: North-face dock bank shows ~30 trailers backed in across z20 image; east-face dock bank ~15 doors; additional doors on south and west faces. Estimated total 50+, conservatively in the '50+' band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two distinct trailer drop yards: (1) north drop yard along Forest Ln with ~25-30 trailer stalls; (2) east drop yard near Hilltop Dr with ~20-25 trailers. Plus on-site staging. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces (north face large bank + east face bank), consistent with separate shipping/receiving operations at a 635k sq ft multi-product plant (Lunchables, Velveeta Skillets, BBQ sauce).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: 2340 Forest Ln, Garland TX - dense Dallas metro industrial fabric. Residential subdivisions immediately south, dense industrial north/east/west. Decidedly Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single connected plant complex - all wings/buildings are physically interconnected as one Oscar Mayer manufacturing campus per Kraft Heinz disclosures (~635,000 sq ft total).
fieldNotes.scale: No discrete truck-scale pad visible in the gate throat or on the apron.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Yes - two dedicated trailer-storage lots separate from active dock staging (north and east).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur clearly visible entering from the north (across Forest Ln) and running south along the west property line. The plant's heritage as a 1949 Oscar Mayer facility is consistent with rail-served meat processing.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Single gate/booth complex - no evidence of a second downstream checkpoint or scale house before the docks.
